checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan non-aggression pacts: standing-30 timed treaties that block new Sol Coalition wars for 90 ticks, with cockpit, CLI and REST parity.

impact_assessment.why: Diplomacy jumps from trade pacts at standing 40 to research pacts at 60 and alliances at 70; there is no low-cost way to buy temporary peace, so aggressive neighbours remain an unavoidable war risk.
impact_assessment.benefits: Standing 30 gains a defensive diplomatic tool, NAPs give players a way to stabilize one border, and the Empire tab shows remaining treaty time.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ShipState gains a persisted non_aggression_until map with a legacy-safe default; dependency: faction war simulation must honor active pairs without changing AI-AI wars; concurrency: signing mutates standings and the treaty map under the engine lock; state: expired treaties must stop protecting without requiring cleanup.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Test signing, standing/war gates, expiry, persistence, war-pair exclusion and UI/CLI wiring first; pass only active Sol Coalition pairs into the war simulator; verify live Edge.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Added persisted timed NAPs, standing/war gates, war-pair exclusion, expiry helpers, cockpit NAP action, CLI parity, REST reuse and 7 regressions; 996 tests pass.
